item.title: Bookshelf – Self-hosted eBook library that runs on object storage
item.description:
📝 epub books/ docker compose run --rm sync --create docker compose up -d The shelf is then on http://localhost:3000. Flags pass through, so docker compose run --rm sync --force and --dry-run behave as they do locally. On Cloudflare Needs a Cloudflare account and npx wrangler login.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/murerkinn/bookshelf
